features: Digital Market routed to H2H.id direct API backend
H2H Member ID PIN and H2H Password stored in Supabase Vault
no Static Egress Gateway required when H2H IP whitelist is empty
H2H HCoin connection test and verification status
H2H prepaid catalog order and status polling
H2H PPOB catalog inquiry payment and status flow
H2H webhook POST support for transaction events
HMAC-SHA256 verification using X-Webhook-Signature and raw request body
Webhook Secret from H2H stored server-side in Supabase Vault
supplier status re-check before order state or wallet refund changes
legacy H2H GET callback compatibility retained
wallet reserve idempotency and automatic refund protections retained
Nomor Virtual retained as an additional service
note: v19 aligns DLavie with H2H.id's signed webhook format: HMAC-SHA256(timestamp.raw_payload, secret_key), raw-body verification, five-minute timestamp tolerance, event headers, and H2H-provided Webhook Secret entry in Admin.
